t: In front of you is a statue of Queen Alexandra, in Whitechapel. She was Queen of the United Kingdom and Empress of India from 1901 to 1910, as the wife of King Edward the Seventh. The statue was made by George Edward Wade, a British sculptor who taught himself much of his art. He is best remembered for his statues of royalty and politicians, so a queen consort fits neatly into his body of work.
